claims: "Mr. Nobody Against Putin" is directed by David Borenstein and Pavel Talankin.
"Mr. Nobody Against Putin" won Best Documentary Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards occurred on March 15, 2026.
"Mr. Nobody Against Putin" won over favorites "The Perfect Neighbor" and "The Alabama Solution".
"Mr. Nobody Against Putin" documents a Russian teacher’s defiance against nationalistic education mandates following the invasion of Ukraine.
"Mr. Nobody Against Putin" is distributed by Kino Lorber.
"The Alabama Solution" is directed by Andrew Jarecki and Charlotte Kaufman.
"The Alabama Solution" is distributed by HBO Documentary Films.
"Come See Me in the Good Light" is directed by Ryan White.
"Come See Me in the Good Light" is distributed by Apple.
"Cutting Through Rocks" is directed by Sara Khaki and Mohammadreza Eyni.
"Cutting Through Rocks" is distributed by Gandom Films.
"The Perfect Neighbor" is directed by Geeta Gandbhir.
"The Perfect Neighbor" is distributed by Netflix.

"Mr. Nobody Against Putin", "The Alabama Solution", "Come See Me in the Good Light", "Cutting Through Rocks", and "The Perfect Neighbor" were nominees for Best Documentary Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.
"All the Empty Rooms" won Best Documentary Short film at the 98th Academy Awards.
"All the Empty Rooms" is distributed by Netflix.
"Mr. Nobody Against Putin" went into the 98th Academy Awards ceremony without major US distribution until January.
"The Alabama Solution" covers prison conditions.
"Come See Me in the Good Light" covers cancer struggles.
"Cutting Through Rocks" covers Iranian women’s rights.
"The Perfect Neighbor" covers gun violence and neighbors.
Filmmaker Geeta Gandbhir was considered a strong contender but lost.
"Cutting Through Rocks" was noted as a rare Iranian documentary nomination.
